# ChunkPlants

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/vegetation/vegetation_scatter.h`](../../../src/logic/vegetation/vegetation_scatter.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

On a chunk: the plants VegetationScatter put on it, destroyed with the chunk.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `plants` | `std::vector<entt::entity>` | the plant entities of the chunk |

## Notes

Emplaced by VegetationScatter (also empty, to mark it done); its on_destroy signal destroys the plants.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: VegetationScatter. Written by: VegetationScatter. Created by: VegetationScatter. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick (scatter) | on the chunk: the list of its plants |
| [VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md) | system | Host | **read** | signal on_destroy<ChunkPlants> (onChunkPlantsDestroyed) | the plants of the chunk being destroyed |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkPlants> in preinit, disconnects in finish.
  - Reads resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs the selected species (info) and a warning per unknown id.
